carmen: Quick idea: emit tiny, verifiable "hints" from the policy compiler that express intent (p95 target, max cost, region prefs) and nothing more. Adapters consume hints and reply with ranked candidates + confidence.

noah: Sounds good. Keep the hint schema minimal and versioned. Example: `{hint_v:1, intent:'interactive', p95_ms:120, max_usd_per_m:0.001}`

priya: Important: adapters must support legacy mode. New mode = `hinted` where adapter uses hint + pinned profile snapshot to score. Always return `profile_snapshot_id` so sims are reproducible.

carmen: Adapter response shape proposal (compact): `{candidates:[{id:'ded-a',score:0.82,conf:0.18,why:'p95 ok'}],profile:'ps-2026-03-01',cid:'r-99'}`

noah: Observability: every decision event logs `{rationale_id,profile_snapshot,cid,adapter_version}`. Add parity sim stream so we can diff legacy vs hinted decisions.

priya: Rollout plan: 1) compiler emits hints (no runtime change) 2) adapter shim reads hints in sim-only and writes `hint-sim` logs 3) run parity sims over production traces 4) canary enable for small tenant set with double-check against legacy router; auto rollback on p99 or cost regressions.

ops-bot: created ticket #ops/adapter-hints and dashboard stub `routing.hints.parity`.

noah: Open questions to capture in RFC: exact `conf` semantics, select_threshold defaults, profile snapshot TTL, encryption of hint manifests, and fallback ordering when no candidate passes.

carmen: I'll draft RFC appendix with schema, telemetry contract, and migration checklist. 48h draft window then 30m sync. Thumbs?

priya: +1

noah: +1

ops-bot: scheduled meeting: adapters-hint-sync (30m)
